title: FEP Agent Append-only Run Event v0.2
description: v0.2 event system (ADR-0010 §5.3/§11.6): five independent mechanism event types; neutral_inquiry and retrieval_completion_check are retired from the current enum and only exist on the v0.1 track for historical journal replay. P2-11 DC 清理 (2026-08-31, MODEL-RESIDUAL-PRESSURE-FOLLOWUP 裁决 2) retires diagnostic_coverage_checkpoint and checkpoint_response — the diagnostic-coverage forced-template mechanism is deleted; the v0.2 producer never writes them and historical v0.2 journals containing them are no longer valid against this schema. GAP-RETRIEVAL-TOOLS adds retrieval_mode_transition, retrieval_result_committed and retrieval_activation_restored (ADR-0010 §3.7.1/§3.3.3/§3.3). F7 (2026-08-15) adds epoch_archive_write_failed (blackboard plan-epoch archive write failure audit trace, ADR-0010 §14.15). P2-13 B3 (2026-09-03, ADR-0010 §14.52) adds session_archive (会话关闭/归档时对话 + 黑板 live 视图合成单一 gzip 包——纯打包、原子写 + digest、每条会话存档一次；archive_id/path/digest/status/attempts/fatigue_pct；不新增 blackboard_fold——渲染折叠零持久化、逐读事件只会产生噪声). ORZ-CACHE-CONTEXT-COST (2026-08-15, ADR-0010 §3.5 条6/§14.9) adds request_header_change (model-request header = system+tools+config fingerprint; only emitted on initial/change for cache-miss attribution and probe-accuracy auditing). PLAN-FIRST 阶段 A (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17) adds plan_write (first-round plan gate result: plan identity/goal/step count, mechanical validation, one-refill attempt progression and degrade reason; PLAN_FIRST_BLACKBOARD_DESIGN §3-§5). PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱) adds console_mode_transition (console/direct dual-mode transition decision record; PLAN_FIRST_BLACKBOARD_DESIGN §7) and console_order_written (blackboard_action_write order identity + step binding + mechanical stamps; PLAN_FIRST_BLACKBOARD_DESIGN §5-§6). P0-E 第 4 项 (2026-08-17, ADR-0010 §14.21 项 3) adds console_order_rejected (pre-issuance rejection of a written order — order_stale / step_not_done / budget_insufficient / registry / contract / target / ACAF / policy / mode gates — carrying order identity, envelope step, phase, rejection code and reason; the result-bar receipt stays as the human-readable view). FUS-LEDGER-FOLD-STATE (2026-08-18, ADR-0010 §14.26) adds ledger_fold_advance (mechanical action-ledger fold advance at the loop-top gap — the request-view prefix is rewritten once per fold window, so the event carries the new fold point, folded-round count and triggering view estimate for cache-miss attribution; emitted only on a real advance). FUS-LEDGER-FOLD-STATE (2026-08-18, ADR-0010 §14.28 审查修复) adds ledger_fold_write_failed (external-ledger append failure at a fold advance — the fold state is rolled back, the failure counted, and after the failure budget folding is disabled for the loop; the audit trace of the degrade path that keeps the session moving with the unfolded view). MIDSTREAM-DECODE-RETRY (2026-08-21, ADR-0010 §14.37 第 2 项) adds transport_retry (transport 重试计数事件面——一次逻辑模型请求内零 chunk/中段截断重试的 recovered/exhausted 摘要，设计 §2.3 随本设计一并实施)。MECHANICAL-AUDIT-LAYER (2026-08-24, ADR-0010 §14.39 / MECHANICAL_AUDIT_LAYER_DESIGN_2026-08-24 §2.4) adds mechanical_audit_update (静默机械审查层轻量事件留痕——对象键覆盖写/键/轮/摘要/异常；step/契约类只事件留痕不上报告；报告随最终答案前中立问询轮注入且不进归档)。TER (2026-09-03, TODO2 T0.2 / 设计稿 §3.3/§10-S0): adds budget_cue_injected — F6 push 档中性预算提示（remaining_seconds / rounds_used / threshold_seconds；默认 off 零注入、≤4 次/run，verifier 强制）；tool_completed 在 v0.2 轨换 v0.2 payload（W-F13b output_truncated / total_bytes / output_object_id）；tool_running 增 idle-kill 形态（status=idle_killed + reason）。
